+# Finite Configuration Acquisition
+
+## Abstract
+
+Finite configuration acquisition from an installed stationary port.
+
+**Theorem 1.1 (The history criterion and an executable finite table).**
+
+$$\forall E: \operatorname{Type}, [\operatorname{Fintype}\left(E\right)] [\operatorname{DecidableEq}\left(E\right)], F: \operatorname{Finset}\left(\operatorname{Finset}\left(E\right)\right), \operatorname{Nonempty}\left(F\right) \implies \forall Q: \operatorname{Type}, r: \operatorname{State}\left(F\right) \to Q,\\{}{{\exists p: \operatorname{History}\left(E, Q\right) \to \operatorname{Decision}\left(F\right), \operatorname{Acquires}\left(r, p\right)} \iff \operatorname{CommonEnabled}\left(r\right)} \land {\operatorname{CommonEnabled}\left(r\right) \iff \operatorname{IsolatedSinks}\left(r\right)} \land {\operatorname{CommonEnabled}\left(r\right) \iff \operatorname{FiniteAcquirable}\left(r\right)}.$$
+
+*Proof.* Machine-checked in Lean as `D5/S3/ConceptDynamics/Agency/FiniteConfigurationAcquisition.acquisition_criterion` (`✓ std3`). ∎
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+E is a finite set of named events and F is any nonempty family of subsets of E. Every member of F may be the initial state. An event is enabled at C precisely when it is absent from C and inserting it produces a member of F. Sinks are defined by the absence of such events; no lower-set, reachability or connectedness assumption is imposed.
+
+A history consists of the current port symbol and the complete reverse list of requested events paired with their preceding symbols. The entry history has an empty list. A successful Run stops with a claim equal to the actual current state, or makes one legal requested insertion and continues with its actual new port symbol. There are no refusal probes, enabled menus, resets, copies, extra reads or unrecorded changes.
+
+Acquires quantifies all initial states and allows arbitrary mathematical functions of the complete history. On a nonsingleton entry fiber, the common first decision cannot be a correct stop for every member. It must therefore request one event enabled at every member. This argument imposes no restriction on later history use.
+
+CommonEnabled asks for a common enabled event on every nonsingleton fiber. IsolatedSinks says that each sink has its own singleton fiber and that every fiber containing a nonsink has a common enabled event. Singleton nonsinks can still stop immediately when identified.
+
+FiniteAcquirable supplies an injective natural-number encoding on the effective symbol image, a literal finite instruction list, a fixed fallback, and actual bounded runs of tablePolicy. The lookup program compares natural codes and recurses on the finite list, so each decision terminates by finite computation. Encoding and table preparation are part of the known model and code table. The existing common-legal-action selection theorem supplies the table entries; the execution and termination proof uses the strict decrease of the number of missing events.
+
+The equivalence sandwiches every finite-computation history protocol between the unrestricted history class and an explicitly constructed finite-table protocol. Starting at C, the latter performs at most card E minus card C additions, then returns its actual stopping configuration. It permits zero additions and an early stop at a nonsink. The result optimizes neither preparation, memory, computation time nor physical realization.
+
+## References
+
+- Truth anchor: `D5/S3/ConceptDynamics/Agency/FiniteConfigurationAcquisition.acquisition_criterion`
+- Dependency: [D5/S3/ConceptDynamics/Agency/DeterministicSafePolicyExistence](DeterministicSafePolicyExistence.md)

+# Minimum Installed Readout
+
+## Abstract
+
+The attained minimum effective installed alphabet for arbitrary finite configuration families.
+
+**Theorem 1.1 (Sink labels plus an actual minimum enabled-event hitting set).**
+
+$$\forall E: \operatorname{Type}, [\operatorname{Fintype}\left(E\right)] [\operatorname{DecidableEq}\left(E\right)], F: \operatorname{Finset}\left(\operatorname{Finset}\left(E\right)\right), \operatorname{Nonempty}\left(F\right) \implies\\{}{{\exists H: \operatorname{Finset}\left(E\right), \operatorname{Hits}\left(F, H\right) \land \lvert H\rvert =\operatorname{hittingNumber}\left(F\right)} \land {\forall K: \operatorname{Finset}\left(E\right), \operatorname{Hits}\left(F, K\right) \implies \operatorname{hittingNumber}\left(F\right) \leq \lvert K\rvert }} \land {\forall Q: \operatorname{Type}, r: \operatorname{State}\left(F\right) \to Q, {\exists p: \operatorname{History}\left(E, Q\right) \to \operatorname{Decision}\left(F\right), \operatorname{Acquires}\left(r, p\right)} \implies \lvert \operatorname{sinks}\left(F\right)\rvert +\operatorname{hittingNumber}\left(F\right) \leq \operatorname{effectiveSize}\left(r\right)} \land {\exists r: \operatorname{State}\left(F\right) \to \operatorname{Sum}\left(\operatorname{State}\left(F\right), E\right), \operatorname{FiniteAcquirable}\left(r\right) \land \operatorname{effectiveSize}\left(r\right)=\lvert \operatorname{sinks}\left(F\right)\rvert +\operatorname{hittingNumber}\left(F\right)}.$$
+
+*Proof.* Machine-checked in Lean as `D5/S3/ConceptDynamics/Agency/MinimumInstalledReadout.installed_readout_optimum` (`✓ std3`). ∎
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+For the finite insertion model, sinks F contains the operational sinks. Hits F H means that H contains an enabled event for every nonsink. The number tau is the least cardinality of a hitting set, defined by minimization over natural numbers. The full event set hits every nonempty enabled set, so this minimum exists. The theorem includes both a minimizing set and its universal minimality property.
+
+effectiveSize r is the cardinality of the actual image of r on F, regardless of its symbol carrier. For an arbitrary successful history policy, each sink has a private symbol. Every other effective fiber has a common enabled event, including singleton nonsinks. Choosing one event per such fiber produces a hitting set whose size is no larger than the number of those fibers. This proves the lower bound for unrestricted history policies.
+
+For attainment, choose a minimum hitting set H and, at each nonsink C, choose one event in H enabled at C. Give a sink its own left label C and a nonsink the right label of its selected event. The two label families are disjoint. Each right-label fiber has a common enabled event, and every sink label is private. The finite acquisition criterion constructs the actual finite-table policy and proves the addition bound. Its effective image has at most card T plus card H symbols; the lower bound forces equality.
+
+The family may be disconnected and need not contain the empty configuration or any root. The empty event type, a singleton family, and an all-sink family are included. If every state is a sink, the empty hitting set has minimum size zero and the readout directly identifies each state. Only the number of effective installed symbols is minimized. Same-run recovery of an earlier state, source transport and physical implementation require their own interfaces.
+
+## References
+
+- Truth anchor: `D5/S3/ConceptDynamics/Agency/MinimumInstalledReadout.installed_readout_optimum`
+- Dependency: [D5/S3/ConceptDynamics/Agency/FiniteConfigurationAcquisition](FiniteConfigurationAcquisition.md)

+/- GID: D5/S3/ConceptDynamics/Agency/FiniteConfigurationAcquisition
+   generality: G
+   mirror-B: D5/B/S3/ConceptDynamics/Agency/FiniteConfigurationAcquisition
+   mirror-E: none(waiver:evidence-not-specified-by-formal-manifest)
+   anchors: []
+   utility: none
+   digest: History-based safe acquisition is equivalent to common enabled events and has a finite table implementation. -/
+
+import D5.S3.ConceptDynamics.Agency.DeterministicSafePolicyExistence
+import Mathlib.Data.Finset.Powerset
+import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Card
+import Mathlib.Data.List.Basic
+import Mathlib.Tactic
+
+/-! Legal insertion runs and finite-table acquisition for arbitrary configuration families. -/
+
+set_option autoImplicit false
+set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
+
+namespace D5.S3.ConceptDynamics.Agency.FiniteConfigurationAcquisition
+
+universe u v
+variable {E : Type u} [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E]
+
+abbrev State (F : Finset (Finset E)) := {C // C ∈ F}
+
+def Enabled (F : Finset (Finset E)) (C : State F) (e : E) : Prop :=
+  e ∉ C.val ∧ insert e C.val ∈ F
+
+def Sink (F : Finset (Finset E)) (C : State F) : Prop :=
+  ∀ e, ¬ Enabled F C e
+
+def successor (F : Finset (Finset E)) (C : State F) (e : E)
+    (h : Enabled F C e) : State F := ⟨insert e C.val, h.2⟩
+
+def remaining (F : Finset (Finset E)) (C : State F) : ℕ :=
+  Fintype.card E - C.val.card
+
+/-- The first component is the current symbol; the list stores all earlier
+requested events and their preceding symbols, in reverse chronological order. -/
+abbrev History (E : Type u) (Q : Type v) := Q × List (E × Q)
+
+abbrev Decision (F : Finset (Finset E)) := State F ⊕ E
+
+def record {Q : Type v} (h : History E Q) (e : E) (q : Q) : History E Q :=
+  (q, (e, h.1) :: h.2)
+
+/-- Only a requested legal insertion changes the state. A stop is successful
+exactly when its claim is the actual current configuration. -/
+inductive Run {F : Finset (Finset E)} {Q : Type v}
+    (r : State F → Q) (p : History E Q → Decision F) :
+    State F → History E Q → ℕ → Prop
+  | stop (C : State F) (h : History E Q) (hp : p h = Sum.inl C) : Run r p C h 0
+  | step (C : State F) (h : History E Q) (e : E) (n : ℕ)
+      (hp : p h = Sum.inr e) (he : Enabled F C e)
+      (tail : Run r p (successor F C e he)
+        (record h e (r (successor F C e he))) n) : Run r p C h (n + 1)
+
+/-- No restriction on retained history or the mathematical decision function
+is used in this semantic upper class of protocols. -/
+def Acquires {F : Finset (Finset E)} {Q : Type v}
+    (r : State F → Q) (p : History E Q → Decision F) : Prop :=
+  ∀ C, ∃ n, Run r p C (r C, []) n
+
+def CommonEnabled {F : Finset (Finset E)} {Q : Type v}
+    (r : State F → Q) : Prop :=
+  ∀ C, (∃ D, r D = r C ∧ D ≠ C) →
+    ∃ e, ∀ D, r D = r C → Enabled F D e
+
+def IsolatedSinks {F : Finset (Finset E)} {Q : Type v}
+    (r : State F → Q) : Prop :=
+  (∀ C, Sink F C → ∀ D, r D = r C → D = C) ∧
+  (∀ C, ¬ Sink F C → ∃ e, ∀ D, r D = r C → Enabled F D e)
+
+/-- A literal finite instruction table; equality tests are on natural symbol
+codes. Evaluation recurses on this list, and does no query of the source. -/
+def lookup {F : Finset (Finset E)} (q : ℕ) (fallback : Decision F) :
+    List (ℕ × Decision F) → Decision F
+  | [] => fallback
+  | (key, value) :: tail => if q = key then value else lookup q fallback tail
+
+def tablePolicy {F : Finset (Finset E)}
+    (table : List (ℕ × Decision F)) (fallback : Decision F)
+    (h : History E ℕ) : Decision F := lookup h.1 fallback table
+
+/-- The code table is injective on the effective image. The actual policy is
+the finite lookup program above, not an assumed successful executor. -/
+def FiniteAcquirable {F : Finset (Finset E)} {Q : Type v}
+    (r : State F → Q) : Prop :=
+  ∃ encode : Q → ℕ,
+    (∀ C D, encode (r C) = encode (r D) → r C = r D) ∧
+    ∃ (table : List (ℕ × Decision F)) (fallback : Decision F),
+      ∀ C, ∃ n, n ≤ remaining F C ∧
+        Run (encode ∘ r) (tablePolicy table fallback) C (encode (r C), []) n
+
+noncomputable def symbols {F : Finset (Finset E)} {Q : Type v}
+    (r : State F → Q) : Finset Q := by
+  classical
+  exact Finset.univ.image r
+
+private theorem mem_symbols {F : Finset (Finset E)} {Q : Type v}
+    (r : State F → Q) (C : State F) : r C ∈ symbols r := by
+  classical
+  exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨C, Finset.mem_univ _, rfl⟩
+
+private theorem run_stop {F : Finset (Finset E)} {Q : Type v}
+    {r : State F → Q} {p : History E Q → Decision F}
+    {C A : State F} {h : History E Q} {n : ℕ}
+    (hr : Run r p C h n) (hp : p h = Sum.inl A) : A = C := by
+  cases hr with
+  | stop C h hs => exact Sum.inl.inj (hp.symm.trans hs)
+  | step C h e n hs he tail => simp [hp] at hs
+
+private theorem run_request {F : Finset (Finset E)} {Q : Type v}
+    {r : State F → Q} {p : History E Q → Decision F}
+    {C : State F} {e : E} {h : History E Q} {n : ℕ}
+    (hr : Run r p C h n) (hp : p h = Sum.inr e) : Enabled F C e := by
+  cases hr with
+  | stop C h hs => simp [hp] at hs
+  | step C h a n hs he tail =>
+    have : e = a := Sum.inr.inj (hp.symm.trans hs)
+    simpa [this] using he
+
+private theorem first_decision {F : Finset (Finset E)} {Q : Type v}
+    {r : State F → Q} {p : History E Q → Decision F}
+    (success : Acquires r p) : CommonEnabled r := by
+  intro C hC
+  cases hp : p (r C, []) with
+  | inl A =>
+    obtain ⟨D, hD, hne⟩ := hC
+    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := success C
+    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := success D
+    have hAC := run_stop hn hp
+    have hAD := run_stop hm (by simpa only [hD] using hp)
+    exact (hne (hAD.symm.trans hAC)).elim
+  | inr e =>
+    refine ⟨e, ?_⟩
+    intro D hD
+    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := success D
+    exact run_request hn (by simpa only [hD] using hp)
+
+private theorem sink_equivalence {F : Finset (Finset E)} {Q : Type v}
+    (r : State F → Q) : CommonEnabled r ↔ IsolatedSinks r := by
+  classical
+  constructor
+  · intro hc
+    constructor
+    · intro C hs D hD
+      by_contra hne
+      obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := hc C ⟨D, hD, hne⟩
+      exact hs e (he C rfl)
+    · intro C hn
+      by_cases hmany : ∃ D, r D = r C ∧ D ≠ C
+      · exact hc C hmany
+      · have hex : ∃ e, Enabled F C e := by simpa [Sink] using hn
+        obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := hex
+        refine ⟨e, ?_⟩
+        intro D hD
+        have : D = C := by by_contra hne; exact hmany ⟨D, hD, hne⟩
+        simpa [this] using he
+  · rintro ⟨hs, hn⟩ C ⟨D, hD, hne⟩
+    apply hn C
+    intro hc
+    exact hne (hs C hc D hD)
+
+private theorem rank_decreases {F : Finset (Finset E)} (C : State F)
+    (e : E) (he : Enabled F C e) :
+    remaining F (successor F C e he) + 1 = remaining F C := by
+  have hcard := Finset.card_le_univ (s := insert e C.val)
+  have hins := Finset.card_insert_of_notMem he.1
+  simp only [remaining, successor]
+  rw [hins] at hcard ⊢
+  omega
+
+private theorem execute_stationary {F : Finset (Finset E)} {Q : Type v}
+    (r : State F → Q) (select : Q → Decision F)
+    (safe : ∀ C, match select (r C) with
+      | Sum.inl D => D = C
+      | Sum.inr e => Enabled F C e) :
+    ∀ C h, h.1 = r C → ∃ n, n ≤ remaining F C ∧
+      Run r (fun h => select h.1) C h n := by
+  have go : ∀ m C (h : History E Q), remaining F C = m → h.1 = r C →
+      ∃ n, n ≤ remaining F C ∧ Run r (fun h => select h.1) C h n := by
+    intro m
+    induction m using Nat.strong_induction_on with
+    | h m ih =>
+      intro C h hm hq
+      cases hs : select (r C) with
+      | inl D =>
+        have hDC : D = C := by simpa only [hs] using safe C
+        refine ⟨0, Nat.zero_le _, Run.stop C h ?_⟩
+        simpa only [hq, hDC] using hs
+      | inr e =>
+        have he : Enabled F C e := by simpa only [hs] using safe C
+        have hd := rank_decreases C e he
+        have hlt : remaining F (successor F C e he) < m := by omega
+        obtain ⟨n, hn, hr⟩ := ih _ hlt (successor F C e he)
+          (record h e (r (successor F C e he))) rfl rfl
+        refine ⟨n + 1, by omega, Run.step C h e n ?_ he hr⟩
+        simpa only [hq] using hs
+  intro C h hq
+  exact go (remaining F C) C h rfl hq
+
+private theorem lookup_map {F : Finset (Finset E)}
+    (keys : List ℕ) (select : ℕ → Decision F) (fallback : Decision F)
+    {q : ℕ} (hq : q ∈ keys) :
+    lookup q fallback (keys.map fun k => (k, select k)) = select q := by
+  induction keys with
+  | nil => simp at hq
+  | cons k keys ih =>
+    by_cases he : q = k
+    · simp [lookup, he]
+    · simp only [List.mem_cons] at hq
+      have ht : q ∈ keys := hq.resolve_left he
+      simpa [lookup, he] using ih ht
+
+private theorem finite_table {F : Finset (Finset E)} (hF : F.Nonempty)
+    {Q : Type v} (r : State F → Q) (hc : CommonEnabled r) : FiniteAcquirable r := by
+  classical
+  let encode (q : Q) := (symbols r).toList.idxOf q
+  have heq (C D : State F) (h : encode (r C) = encode (r D)) : r C = r D :=
+    (List.idxOf_inj (by simpa using mem_symbols r C)).mp h
+  let s : State F → ℕ := encode ∘ r
+  have hcs : CommonEnabled s := by
+    intro C ⟨D, hD, hne⟩
+    obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := hc C ⟨D, heq D C hD, hne⟩
+    exact ⟨e, fun A hA => he A (heq A C hA)⟩
+  let legal (C : State F) : Set (Decision F) :=
+    {a | match a with | Sum.inl D => D = C | Sum.inr e => Enabled F C e}
+  have common : ∀ z : Set.range s,
+      ({a | ∀ C, s C = z.val → a ∈ legal C} : Set (Decision F)).Nonempty := by
+    intro z
+    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := z.property
+    by_cases hmany : ∃ D, s D = s C ∧ D ≠ C
+    · obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := hcs C hmany
+      exact ⟨Sum.inr e, fun D hD => he D (hD.trans hC.symm)⟩
+    · refine ⟨Sum.inl C, ?_⟩
+      intro D hD
+      change C = D
+      by_contra hne
+      exact hmany ⟨D, hD.trans hC.symm, Ne.symm hne⟩
+  obtain ⟨policy, hp⟩ :=
+    (D5.S3.ConceptDynamics.Agency.DeterministicSafePolicyExistence.deterministic_safe_policy_exists_iff
+      s legal).mpr common
+  obtain ⟨C₀, hC₀⟩ := hF
+  let fallback : Decision F := Sum.inl ⟨C₀, hC₀⟩
+  let select (q : ℕ) : Decision F :=
+    if hq : q ∈ Set.range s then policy ⟨q, hq⟩ else fallback
+  have hsafe (C : State F) : select (s C) ∈ legal C := by
+    have hmem : s C ∈ Set.range s := ⟨C, rfl⟩
+    simpa only [select, dif_pos hmem] using hp ⟨s C, hmem⟩ C rfl
+  let keys := (symbols s).toList
+  let table := keys.map fun q => (q, select q)
+  have heval (C : State F) : lookup (s C) fallback table = select (s C) :=
+    lookup_map keys select fallback (by simpa [keys] using mem_symbols s C)
+  have htable (C : State F) :
+      (match lookup (s C) fallback table with
+      | Sum.inl D => D = C | Sum.inr e => Enabled F C e) := by
+    rw [heval]
+    exact hsafe C
+  refine ⟨encode, heq, table, fallback, ?_⟩
+  intro C
+  exact execute_stationary s (fun q => lookup q fallback table) htable C (s C, []) rfl
+
+private theorem decoded_run {F : Finset (Finset E)} {Q : Type v}
+    (r : State F → Q) (encode : Q → ℕ)
+    (p : History E ℕ → Decision F) :
+    ∀ C h n, Run (encode ∘ r) p C
+      (encode h.1, h.2.map fun eq => (eq.1, encode eq.2)) n →
+      Run r (fun h => p (encode h.1, h.2.map fun eq => (eq.1, encode eq.2))) C h n := by
+  intro C h n hr
+  generalize hx : (encode h.1, h.2.map fun eq => (eq.1, encode eq.2)) = code at hr
+  induction hr generalizing h with
+  | stop C code hp =>
+    exact Run.stop C h (by simpa only [hx] using hp)
+  | step C code e n hp he tail ih =>
+    refine Run.step C h e n (by simpa only [hx] using hp) he ?_
+    apply ih (record h e (r (successor F C e he)))
+    simp [record, hx.symm]
+
+/-- Full acquired-history policies, common enabled events on every nonsingleton
+fiber, and isolated sinks with common events on the other fibers are equivalent.
+The equivalent finite program performs at most the initial missing-event count
+of legal insertions and returns its actual stopping configuration. -/
+theorem acquisition_criterion {F : Finset (Finset E)} (hF : F.Nonempty)
+    {Q : Type v} (r : State F → Q) :
+    ((∃ p : History E Q → Decision F, Acquires r p) ↔ CommonEnabled r) ∧
+    (CommonEnabled r ↔ IsolatedSinks r) ∧
+    (CommonEnabled r ↔ FiniteAcquirable r) := by
+  have finite_to_history : FiniteAcquirable r → ∃ p, Acquires r p := by
+    rintro ⟨encode, _, table, fallback, hs⟩
+    refine ⟨fun h => tablePolicy table fallback
+      (encode h.1, h.2.map fun eq => (eq.1, encode eq.2)), ?_⟩
+    intro C
+    obtain ⟨n, _, hn⟩ := hs C
+    exact ⟨n, decoded_run r encode (tablePolicy table fallback) C (r C, []) n hn⟩
+  refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, sink_equivalence r, ⟨finite_table hF r, ?_⟩⟩
+  · rintro ⟨p, hp⟩
+    exact first_decision hp
+  · intro hc
+    exact finite_to_history (finite_table hF r hc)
+  · intro hf
+    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := finite_to_history hf
+    exact first_decision hp
+
+#print axioms acquisition_criterion
+
+end D5.S3.ConceptDynamics.Agency.FiniteConfigurationAcquisition

+   digest: The attained effective installed alphabet is the sink count plus the minimum enabled-event hitting number. -/
+
+import D5.S3.ConceptDynamics.Agency.FiniteConfigurationAcquisition
+import Mathlib.Data.Nat.Find
+
+/-! Effective symbol counts and the enabled-event hitting minimum. -/
+
+set_option autoImplicit false
+set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
+
+namespace D5.S3.ConceptDynamics.Agency.MinimumInstalledReadout
+
+open D5.S3.ConceptDynamics.Agency.FiniteConfigurationAcquisition
+
+universe u v
+variable {E : Type u} [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E]
+
+noncomputable def sinks (F : Finset (Finset E)) : Finset (State F) := by
+  classical
+  exact Finset.univ.filter (Sink F)
+
+noncomputable def nonsinks (F : Finset (Finset E)) : Finset (State F) := by
+  classical
+  exact Finset.univ.filter (fun C => ¬ Sink F C)
+
+def Hits (F : Finset (Finset E)) (H : Finset E) : Prop :=
+  ∀ C : State F, ¬ Sink F C → ∃ e ∈ H, Enabled F C e
+
+private theorem hitting_exists (F : Finset (Finset E)) :
+    ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ H : Finset E, Hits F H ∧ H.card = n := by
+  classical
+  refine ⟨Fintype.card E, Finset.univ, ?_, Finset.card_univ⟩
+  intro C hn
+  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ : ∃ e, Enabled F C e := by simpa [Sink] using hn
+  exact ⟨e, Finset.mem_univ _, he⟩
+
+noncomputable def hittingNumber (F : Finset (Finset E)) : ℕ := by
+  classical
+  exact Nat.find (hitting_exists F)
+
+private theorem minimum_hitting (F : Finset (Finset E)) :
+    (∃ H : Finset E, Hits F H ∧ H.card = hittingNumber F) ∧
+    ∀ K : Finset E, Hits F K → hittingNumber F ≤ K.card := by
+  classical
+  exact ⟨Nat.find_spec (hitting_exists F),
+    fun K hK => Nat.find_min' (hitting_exists F) ⟨K, hK, rfl⟩⟩
+
+noncomputable def effectiveSize {F : Finset (Finset E)} {Q : Type v}
+    (r : State F → Q) : ℕ := (symbols r).card
+
+private theorem mem_sinks (F : Finset (Finset E)) (C : State F) :
+    C ∈ sinks F ↔ Sink F C := by
+  classical
+  simp [sinks]
+
+private theorem mem_nonsinks (F : Finset (Finset E)) (C : State F) :
+    C ∈ nonsinks F ↔ ¬ Sink F C := by
+  classical
+  simp [nonsinks]
+
+private theorem effective_lower_bound {F : Finset (Finset E)} (hF : F.Nonempty)
+    {Q : Type v} (r : State F → Q) (hc : CommonEnabled r) :
+    (sinks F).card + hittingNumber F ≤ effectiveSize r := by
+  classical
+  obtain ⟨isolated, common⟩ := (acquisition_criterion hF r).2.1.mp hc
+  let ts := (sinks F).image r
+  let ns := (nonsinks F).image r
+  have ht : ts.card = (sinks F).card := by
+    apply Finset.card_image_of_injOn
+    intro C hC D hD hCD
+    exact (isolated C ((mem_sinks F C).mp hC) D hCD.symm).symm
+  have disjoint : Disjoint ts ns := by
+    apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
+    intro q hqt hqn
+    obtain ⟨C, hC, hCq⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hqt
+    obtain ⟨D, hD, hDq⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hqn
+    have hDC := isolated C ((mem_sinks F C).mp hC) D (hDq.trans hCq.symm)
+    exact ((mem_nonsinks F D).mp hD) (hDC ▸ (mem_sinks F C).mp hC)
+  have union : ts ∪ ns = symbols r := by
+    ext q
+    simp only [ts, ns, symbols, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_image,
+      Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
+    constructor
+    · rintro (⟨C, hC, rfl⟩ | ⟨C, hC, rfl⟩) <;> exact ⟨C, rfl⟩
+    · rintro ⟨C, rfl⟩
+      by_cases hs : Sink F C
+      · exact Or.inl ⟨C, (mem_sinks F C).mpr hs, rfl⟩
+      · exact Or.inr ⟨C, (mem_nonsinks F C).mpr hs, rfl⟩
+  have hcount : effectiveSize r = (sinks F).card + ns.card := by
+    rw [effectiveSize, ← union, Finset.card_union_of_disjoint disjoint, ht]
+  have hex (q : {q // q ∈ ns}) :
+      ∃ e : E, ∀ C, r C = q.val → Enabled F C e := by
+    obtain ⟨C, hC, hCq⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp q.property
+    obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := common C ((mem_nonsinks F C).mp hC)
+    exact ⟨e, fun D hD => he D (hD.trans hCq.symm)⟩
+  choose pick hpick using hex
+  let H : Finset E := ns.attach.image pick
+  have hH : Hits F H := by
+    intro C hn
+    have hq : r C ∈ ns := Finset.mem_image.mpr
+      ⟨C, (mem_nonsinks F C).mpr hn, rfl⟩
+    refine ⟨pick ⟨r C, hq⟩, ?_, hpick ⟨r C, hq⟩ C rfl⟩
+    exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨⟨r C, hq⟩, Finset.mem_attach .., rfl⟩
+  have hmin := (minimum_hitting F).2 H hH
+  have hcard : H.card ≤ ns.card := by
+    simpa [H] using (Finset.card_image_le (s := ns.attach) (f := pick))
+  omega
+
+private theorem attaining_readout {F : Finset (Finset E)} (hF : F.Nonempty)
+    (H : Finset E) (hH : Hits F H) :
+    ∃ r : State F → State F ⊕ E,
+      FiniteAcquirable r ∧ effectiveSize r ≤ (sinks F).card + H.card := by
+  classical
+  let chooseEvent (C : State F) (hn : ¬ Sink F C) : E :=
+    Classical.choose (hH C hn)
+  have choose_mem (C : State F) (hn : ¬ Sink F C) : chooseEvent C hn ∈ H :=
+    (Classical.choose_spec (hH C hn)).1
+  have choose_enabled (C : State F) (hn : ¬ Sink F C) :
+      Enabled F C (chooseEvent C hn) := (Classical.choose_spec (hH C hn)).2
+  let r (C : State F) : State F ⊕ E :=
+    if hs : Sink F C then Sum.inl C else Sum.inr (chooseEvent C hs)
+  have hi : IsolatedSinks r := by
+    constructor
+    · intro C hs D hD
+      by_cases hd : Sink F D
+      · simpa [r, hs, hd] using hD
+      · simp [r, hs, hd] at hD
+    · intro C hn
+      refine ⟨chooseEvent C hn, ?_⟩
+      intro D hD
+      by_cases hd : Sink F D
+      · simp [r, hn, hd] at hD
+      · have he : chooseEvent D hd = chooseEvent C hn := by
+          simpa [r, hn, hd] using hD
+        simpa only [he] using choose_enabled D hd
+  have hc : CommonEnabled r := (acquisition_criterion hF r).2.1.mpr hi
+  have hf := (acquisition_criterion hF r).2.2.mp hc
+  let labels : Finset (State F ⊕ E) :=
+    ((sinks F).image Sum.inl) ∪ (H.image Sum.inr)
+  have hsub : symbols r ⊆ labels := by
+    intro q hq
+    obtain ⟨C, rfl⟩ : ∃ C, r C = q := by
+      simpa only [symbols, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] using hq
+    by_cases hs : Sink F C
+    · apply Finset.mem_union_left
+      exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨C, (mem_sinks F C).mpr hs, by simp [r, hs]⟩
+    · apply Finset.mem_union_right
+      exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨chooseEvent C hs, choose_mem C hs, by simp [r, hs]⟩
+  have hcard : labels.card ≤ (sinks F).card + H.card := by
+    exact (Finset.card_union_le _ _).trans (Nat.add_le_add
+      (Finset.card_image_le) (Finset.card_image_le))
+  exact ⟨r, hf, (Finset.card_le_card hsub).trans hcard⟩
+
+/-- For every arbitrary nonempty finite configuration family, the true minimum
+hitting number exists, every history-based feasible installed port uses at
+least the sink count plus that number of effective symbols, and a finite-table
+safe terminating protocol attains equality. -/
+theorem installed_readout_optimum (F : Finset (Finset E)) (hF : F.Nonempty) :
+    ((∃ H : Finset E, Hits F H ∧ H.card = hittingNumber F) ∧
+      ∀ K : Finset E, Hits F K → hittingNumber F ≤ K.card) ∧
+    (∀ (Q : Type v) (r : State F → Q),
+      (∃ p : History E Q → Decision F, Acquires r p) →
+      (sinks F).card + hittingNumber F ≤ effectiveSize r) ∧
+    (∃ r : State F → State F ⊕ E, FiniteAcquirable r ∧
+      effectiveSize r = (sinks F).card + hittingNumber F) := by
+  refine ⟨minimum_hitting F, ?_, ?_⟩
+  · intro Q r hp
+    exact effective_lower_bound hF r ((acquisition_criterion hF r).1.mp hp)
+  · obtain ⟨H, hH, hcard⟩ := (minimum_hitting F).1
+    obtain ⟨r, hf, hbound⟩ := attaining_readout hF H hH
+    have hlower := effective_lower_bound hF r
+      ((acquisition_criterion hF r).2.2.mpr hf)
+    exact ⟨r, hf, Nat.le_antisymm (by simpa [hcard] using hbound) hlower⟩
+
+#print axioms installed_readout_optimum
+
+end D5.S3.ConceptDynamics.Agency.MinimumInstalledReadout

+import D5.S3.ConceptDynamics.Agency.FiniteConfigurationAcquisition
+import LeanInformationAuditInterface.Contract.Registration
+import Reg.Support.DependentFamily
+
+/-! Dependent-family realization of the acquired-history criterion. -/
+
+noncomputable section
+open LeanInformationAudit
+open D5.S3.ConceptDynamics.InformationEscape.DependentFamily
+open D5.S3.ConceptDynamics.Agency.FiniteConfigurationAcquisition
+
+namespace Reg.D5.S3.ConceptDynamics.Agency.FiniteConfigurationAcquisition
+universe u v
+
+structure Model where
+  Event : Type u
+  finiteEvent : Fintype Event
+  eventEq : DecidableEq Event
+  family : Finset (Finset Event)
+  nonempty : family.Nonempty
+  Symbol : Type v
+  readout : State family → Symbol
+
+attribute [instance] Model.finiteEvent Model.eventEq
+
+def pack {E : Type u} [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E]
+    {F : Finset (Finset E)} (hF : F.Nonempty) {Q : Type v} (r : State F → Q) : Model where
+  Event := E
+  finiteEvent := inferInstance
+  eventEq := inferInstance
+  family := F
+  nonempty := hF
+  Symbol := Q
+  readout := r
+
+abbrev signature : Signature where
+  Params := Model.{u,v}
+  State m := History m.Event m.Symbol → Decision m.family
+  Role := Unit
+  finiteRole := inferInstance
+  nonemptyRole := inferInstance
+  Output _ _ := Prop
+  Anchor := Empty
+  finiteAnchor := inferInstance
+
+def actual : Realization signature.{u,v} :=
+  realize signature (fun _ m p => Acquires m.readout p) (fun e => nomatch e)
+
+def rejected : Realization signature.{u,v} :=
+  realize signature (fun _ _ _ => False) (fun e => nomatch e)
+
+abbrev arena : Arena where
+  signature := signature.{u,v}
+  Law a := ∀ {E : Type u} [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E]
+    {F : Finset (Finset E)} (hF : F.Nonempty) {Q : Type v} (r : State F → Q),
+    ((∃ p : History E Q → Decision F, a.readout () (pack hF r) p) ↔ CommonEnabled r) ∧
+    (CommonEnabled r ↔ IsolatedSinks r) ∧
+    (CommonEnabled r ↔ FiniteAcquirable r)
+
+def small : Model.{u,v} where
+  Event := ULift.{u} Unit
+  finiteEvent := inferInstance
+  eventEq := inferInstance
+  family := {∅}
+  nonempty := Finset.singleton_nonempty _
+  Symbol := ULift.{v} Unit
+  readout := fun _ => ULift.up ()
+
+private theorem state_eq (C D : State small.family) : C = D := by
+  apply Subtype.ext
+  exact (Finset.mem_singleton.mp C.property).trans (Finset.mem_singleton.mp D.property).symm
+
+private theorem small_common : CommonEnabled small.readout := by
+  intro C h
+  obtain ⟨D, _, hne⟩ := h
+  exact (hne (state_eq D C)).elim
+
+private theorem rejected_law : ¬ arena.{u,v}.Law rejected := by
+  intro h
+  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := (h small.nonempty small.readout).1.mpr small_common
+  exact hp
+
+private theorem dependence : ObservationalDependence signature.{u,v} actual := by
+  intro i
+  let C : State small.family := ⟨∅, Finset.mem_singleton_self _⟩
+  let good : History small.Event small.Symbol → Decision small.family := fun _ => Sum.inl C
+  let bad : History small.Event small.Symbol → Decision small.family := fun _ => Sum.inr (ULift.up ())
+  have hg : Acquires small.readout good := by
+    intro D
+    refine ⟨0, Run.stop D (small.readout D, []) ?_⟩
+    exact congrArg Sum.inl (state_eq C D)
+  have hb : ¬ Acquires small.readout bad := by
+    intro h
+    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := h C
+    cases hn with
+    | stop D h hp => simp [bad] at hp
+    | step D h e n hp he tail =>
+      exact Finset.insert_ne_empty e _ (Finset.mem_singleton.mp he.2)
+  refine ⟨small, good, bad, ?_⟩
+  intro heq
+  exact hb (heq.mp hg)
+
+def family : Registration arena.{u,v} (type_of% (@acquisition_criterion.{u,v})) where
+  actual := actual
+  bridge := Iff.rfl
+  variation := ⟨@acquisition_criterion, rejected, rejected_law⟩
+  sensitivity := ⟨fun i => ⟨rejected,
+    fun j hj => (hj (Subsingleton.elim j i)).elim, rfl, rejected_law⟩,
+    fun e => nomatch e⟩
+  dependence := dependence
+
+def registration : Contract.Registration.{_, _, _, 0, 0, 0, _, _, _, _, _, 0}
+    (@acquisition_criterion.{u,v}) (type_of% (actual.{u,v})) Unit Unit := {
+  unitName := `D5.S3.ConceptDynamics.Agency.FiniteConfigurationAcquisition.acquisition_criterion.__information_unit
+  realizationName := `Reg.D5.S3.ConceptDynamics.Agency.FiniteConfigurationAcquisition.family
+  realizationSource := none
+  generated := false
+  arena := .source ⟨arena⟩
+  objectArena := .source ⟨arena⟩
+  catalog := Lean.Name.anonymous
+  localNames := false
+  realization := .source arena ⟨family⟩
+  correspondence := { stage := .evidence, objectStage := .evidence }
+  bundleNonempty := .absent
+  readout := some (realize signature (fun _ m p => Acquires m.readout p) (fun e => nomatch e))
+  variation := .absent
+  sensitivity := .absent
+  partialSensitivity := none
+  escapeFrom := none
+  sourceSelection := some {
+    owner := `D5.S3.ConceptDynamics.Agency.FiniteConfigurationAcquisition
+    definition := none
+    coordinates := #[0,3,5,6]
+    readouts := #[{
+      path := #["body","body","body","body","body","body","body","fn","arg","fn","arg","arg","body"]
+      stateBinder := 0
+      functionOperand := true
+      stateOperand := none
+      booleanPredicate := false }] }
+  continuation := .unknown
+  familyRecord := none
+  options := #[] }
+
+#print axioms family
+end Reg.D5.S3.ConceptDynamics.Agency.FiniteConfigurationAcquisition

+
+private theorem rejected_law : ¬ arena.{u,v}.Law rejected := by
+  intro h
+  obtain ⟨H, hH, _⟩ := (h ({∅} : Finset (Finset (ULift.{u} Unit)))

+  exact hH

+  let m : Model := pack F

+    obtain ⟨e, he, _⟩ := h C hn
+    simp at he
+  refine ⟨m, ∅, Finset.univ, ?_⟩

+  realizationName := `Reg.D5.S3.ConceptDynamics.Agency.MinimumInstalledReadout.family

+  objectArena := .source ⟨arena⟩
+  catalog := Lean.Name.anonymous
+  localNames := false

+  correspondence := { stage := .evidence, objectStage := .evidence }
+  bundleNonempty := .absent
+  readout := some (realize signature (fun _ m H => Hits m.family H) (fun e => nomatch e))
+  variation := .absent
+  sensitivity := .absent

+  sourceSelection := some {

+    definition := none
+    coordinates := #[0,3]
+    readouts := #[{
+      path := #["body","body","body","body","body","fn","arg","fn","arg","arg","body","fn","arg"]
+      stateBinder := 0
+      functionOperand := true
+      stateOperand := none
+      booleanPredicate := false }] }

+
